UnitStatement: report_renderer crate: deterministic hash-bound HTML calculation-report renderer (DEC-021/A7) consuming a validated CalculationReport, ReportSections, and result rows to emit a single self-contained scriptless HTML document with deterministic byte layout.
The SHA-256 of the rendered HTML bytes is the canonical hash-bound rendered-report evidence, recorded alongside existing envelope-hash evidence.

Three protected-content lint gates apply: the bundled template surface, assembled section text pre-render, and final document text post-render; any blocking finding or blocking validation diagnostic marks the outcome export-blocked.

The renderer does not fetch network resources, embed scripts/external references, compose content from project files, write files, or emit professional approval, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claims.
PDF or paper output produced from the rendered document is a derived, non-hash-bound view (derived_print_view).

SECTION_ORDER constant: fixed render order of 8 sections (model_input_summary, load_cases, results, warnings_assumptions_provenance, audit_manifest, rule_pack_references, limitations, professional_boundary_notice) mirroring report_generator REQUIRED_SECTION_KINDS; rendering never reorders by input ordering.
PUBLIC_REPORT_TEMPLATE_CSS constant: inline local-only stylesheet for the bundled public template using a system font stack with no remote fonts or external URLs.

ResultRow struct: one displayed result row (row_id,label,case_ref,quantity_display,source_ref); caller-formatted display strings are part of the hashed bytes and thus part of the deterministic input contract.
RenderableReportInput struct: complete renderer input document (report_title, calculation_report, report_sections, result_rows).
OutcomeDiagnostic struct: code, severity, message.
OutcomeFinding struct: finding_id, code, severity, path, line, column, excerpt, message, blocking flag.

RenderOutcome struct: html is always produced (a blocked document renders with a visible blocked banner for diagnosis); export_blocked is the gate the app must honor before saving, printing, or exporting the artifact.
escape_html function: escapes &, <, >, double-quote, and single-quote characters in text to HTML entities.
sha256_hex function: computes the lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of a byte slice.
public_report_template function: returns the bundled public template skeleton (lint gate i surface) as the document frame with an empty body slot.
document_frame function: builds the DOCTYPE/html/head/body HTML frame embedding the title and PUBLIC_REPORT_TEMPLATE_CSS around a body.
reference_text / section_reference_text helpers: format a Reference as 'ref_type:ref_id'.
checksum_text helper: formats a ChecksumRef as 'payload (algorithm, canonicalization) = value'.
model_units_text helper: renders a unit BTreeMap as comma-joined 'dimension=unit' pairs, or 'none' when empty.

analysis_status_label helper: maps sections::AnalysisStatus variants to snake_case label strings (model_incomplete, mechanics_solved, rule_inputs_incomplete, user_rule_checked, user_rule_failed, human_review_required).
severity_label helper: maps sections::Severity to info/warning/blocking.
row / header_row helpers: build HTML table <tr> rows from data cells and header cells (header cells escaped).
map_privacy function: maps report::PrivacyClassification variants to linter::PrivacyClassification for lint provenance.
map_redistribution function: maps report::RedistributionStatus variants to linter::RedistributionStatus.
map_review_status function: maps review-status strings to linter::ReviewStatus; unknown strings stay Pending so the lint surface keeps human review visible instead of silently accepting.
lint_provenance function: converts a report::Provenance into linter::Provenance applying the privacy/redistribution/review mappings.
outcome_finding function: converts a linter::LintFinding into an OutcomeFinding including blocking flag from finding.is_blocking().
assemble_sections function: assembles each of the 8 fixed sections into HTML body and lint-text, iterating SECTION_ORDER.
warnings_assumptions_provenance section assembles diagnostics (via sorted_diagnostics), assumptions, user-supplied values, and provenance notes into tables.

audit_manifest section states the SHA-256 of the rendered HTML is computed over its exact bytes and recorded alongside referenced envelope hashes; the rendered-document hash cannot appear inside the bytes it binds.

professional_boundary_notice section renders a fixed boundary statement: the document is a software-generated calculation record, not a professional engineering approval/certification/seal/authentication/code-compliance determination, and human review by a qualified engineer is required before any reliance.
Human Review Record table is completed only by a qualified human reviewer; the software records no approval and pre-fills no field.
html_to_lint_text function: strips HTML tags to feed the linter human-readable section text; escaped entities cannot reconstruct prohibited phrases not in the source text.
status_banner function: renders an Analysis status banner from the disclosure's analysis_status_disclosures labels.
render_calculation_report function: renders the report to a deterministic single-file HTML document, evaluates every gate, and returns an outcome carrying the canonical SHA-256 of the HTML bytes.
render_calculation_report runs report validation and section validation, and applies lint gate (ii) over assembled pre-render section text.
Blocking reasons are accumulated from blocking report-validation diagnostics, blocking section-validation diagnostics, and blocking pre-render lint findings.
When blocking reasons exist, the document body emits an 'EXPORT BLOCKED' banner listing the reasons.
Rendered body footer states printed/PDF copies are derived views and not hash-bound evidence; only the exact bytes of the HTML file are bound by the recorded SHA-256.
Lint gate (iii) lints the final rendered document text post-render; blocking findings add post-render lint blocking reasons.
render_calculation_report sets export_blocked = !blocking_reasons.is_empty() and returns the RenderOutcome with html and sha256_hex.

derived_print_view function: produces the derived print/PDF view by inserting a banner naming the canonical SHA-256 after <body>; the returned document is explicitly NOT hash-bound evidence and exists so paper/PDF copies carry the canonical artifact's identity.
report_renderer render tests (DEC-021): renderer gate and determinism tests; all data invented.

Test fixture_report_renders_deterministic_single_file_html asserts repeated renders produce identical html and sha256, a 64-char hash, DOCTYPE start, scriptless output, no http/https external references, and presence of required section content.
Test fixture_report_is_not_export_blocked asserts the fixture render passes all gates with empty blocking reasons.
Test template_surface_passes_protected_content_lint (lint gate i) asserts the bundled public template surface carries zero blocking lint findings.

Test prohibited_professional_claim_blocks_export asserts a 'Certified ... for construction use' limitation statement produces a blocking ProhibitedProfessionalClaim finding in both pre-render and post-render gates and an EXPORT BLOCKED banner.
Test incomplete_report_is_export_blocked_with_visible_banner asserts an empty report_id yields a REPORT-MISSING-ID blocking reason and an EXPORT BLOCKED banner.

Test derived_print_view_names_canonical_hash_and_is_labeled asserts the derived view contains 'DERIVED VIEW', the canonical sha256, data-derived-view=true, differs from canonical html, and canonical bytes start with DOCTYPE.
Test escaped_markup_cannot_inject_tags asserts a <script> label is HTML-escaped (no <script in output) and escape_html escapes the full character set.
Test renderable_input_round_trips_through_json asserts RenderableReportInput serializes and deserializes via JSON with equal value and equal render sha256.

DiagnosticClass enum (report_sections): SolveBlocking, RuleCheckBlocking, ProvenanceWarning, AssumptionWarning, NonlinearWarning, IpBoundaryWarning, UnitWarning, ReportBlocking.
Severity enum (report_sections): Info, Warning, Blocking.
PrivacyClassification enum (report_sections): PublicMetadata, InventedPublicExample, PrivateProjectData, PrivateRulePackData, ProtectedSuspected, Redacted, Tbd.
RedistributionStatus enum (report_sections): PublicPermissive, PrivateOnly, Unknown, ProtectedSuspected, InventedNonEngineeringExample, Tbd.
ReviewStatus enum (report_sections): Pending, Accepted, Rejected, Quarantined, Tbd.
DimensionId enum (report_sections): Dimensionless, Length, Angle, Force, Moment, Stress, Ratio, Time, Temperature, Pressure, Tbd.
RequiredFor enum (report_sections): MechanicsSolve, UserRuleCheck, Reporting, HumanReview.
ReportCompleteness enum (report_sections): Complete, Qualified, Incomplete, Tbd.
Reference struct (report_sections): ref_type and ref_id; is_complete requires both non-empty after trim.

Provenance struct (report_sections): source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status, privacy_classification; is_complete requires the five string fields non-empty.
Diagnostic struct (report_sections): code, class, severity, source, affected_object, message, remediation, provenance.
Diagnostic::report_blocking constructor: builds a ReportBlocking/Blocking diagnostic with source report_sections:DEL-08-03 and a fixed remediation to provide explicit report-section metadata.
ProfessionalBoundary struct (report_sections): human_review_required plus five software-claim flags (compliance, certification, sealing, approval, authentication).
ProfessionalBoundary::project_default sets human_review_required true and all software-claim flags false.
ProfessionalBoundary::preserves_boundary returns true only when human_review_required is true and all software-claim flags are false.
AnalysisStatusDisclosure struct: status, source, affected_object, explanation, human_review_required, optional human_acceptance_ref.
Quantity struct (report_sections): magnitude (f64), unit, dimension; is_complete requires finite magnitude, non-empty unit, and dimension != Tbd.
UserSuppliedValue struct: value_id, value_category, source, optional quantity, provenance, privacy_classification, required_for, review_status, missing_data_finding.
ReportEffect struct: mechanics_solve_qualified, user_rule_check_qualified, report_completeness, human_review_required.
Assumption struct: assumption_id, owner, source, affected_scope, statement, review_status, optional expiration_or_re_review_trigger, effect, provenance.
Limitation struct: limitation_id, source, affected_scope, statement, effect, provenance.
UnresolvedTbd struct: tbd_id, affected_scope, description, review_needed.

ReportSections struct: report_section_id, model_ref, run_ref, diagnostics, analysis_status_disclosures, provenance_notes, user_supplied_values, assumptions, limitations, unresolved_tbds, professional_boundary.
ReportSectionValidation struct: diagnostics vector; has_blocking_diagnostics returns true if any diagnostic severity is Blocking.
validate_report_sections function: runs all report-section checks and returns the collected blocking diagnostics.
Rule: report sections must identify section, model, and run references; missing identity yields REPORT_SECTION_IDENTITY_MISSING.

Rule: report sections must not make compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claims (preserve professional boundary); violation yields REPORT_SECTION_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION.
Rule: report sections must preserve a HumanReviewRequired analysis-status disclosure; absence yields REPORT_SECTION_HUMAN_REVIEW_STATUS_MISSING.
sorted_diagnostics function: sorts report diagnostics with blocking first, then by class, affected object ref_id, and code.
check_report_diagnostics: report-facing diagnostics must preserve code, source, affected object, message, remediation, and provenance, else REPORT_SECTION_DIAGNOSTIC_INCOMPLETE.
Rule: solve-blocking, rule-check-blocking, and report-blocking diagnostic classes must remain Blocking severity, else REPORT_SECTION_BLOCKING_DIAGNOSTIC_SEVERITY_MISMATCH.
check_status_disclosures: analysis status disclosures must include source, affected object, explanation, and human-review posture, else REPORT_SECTION_STATUS_DISCLOSURE_INCOMPLETE.
Rule: human-review-required disclosures must not be converted into a human acceptance/approval reference, else REPORT_SECTION_HUMAN_REVIEW_MIXED_WITH_ACCEPTANCE.
check_user_values: user-supplied values must include identity, category, source, provenance, and required-use metadata, else REPORT_SECTION_USER_VALUE_METADATA_INCOMPLETE.
Rule: user-supplied values must carry a resolved privacy classification (not Tbd or ProtectedSuspected) before report use, else REPORT_SECTION_USER_VALUE_PRIVACY_UNRESOLVED.
Rule: numeric solve or rule-check user values must carry finite magnitude, unit, and dimension metadata, or an explicit missing-data finding, else REPORT_SECTION_USER_VALUE_QUANTITY_INCOMPLETE.
Rule: missing required data must remain an explicit finding rather than accepted input; a missing_data_finding marked Accepted yields REPORT_SECTION_MISSING_VALUE_MARKED_ACCEPTED.
check_assumptions: assumptions must include owner, source, affected scope, statement, review status, effect, and provenance, else REPORT_SECTION_ASSUMPTION_INCOMPLETE.
check_limitations: limitations must include source, affected scope, statement, effect, and provenance, else REPORT_SECTION_LIMITATION_INCOMPLETE.
check_tbds: unresolved TBDs must include identity, affected scope, description, and review-needed flag, else REPORT_SECTION_TBD_INCOMPLETE.
check_effect: assumption and limitation effects must preserve human-review-required posture, else REPORT_SECTION_EFFECT_HUMAN_REVIEW_MISSING.
check_provenance_record: report provenance records must be complete (source, license, contributor, certification, redistribution, review, privacy), else REPORT_SECTION_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE.

Rule: suspected protected content (redistribution or privacy ProtectedSuspected) must be reported as a finding and cannot be copied into public report artifacts; yields REPORT_SECTION_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED.
Rule: unknown or TBD provenance, redistribution, review, or privacy metadata must remain an explicit unresolved finding; yields REPORT_SECTION_PROVENANCE_UNRESOLVED.

Tests (report_sections): valid_sections_have_no_generated_blocking_diagnostics and targeted tests confirm each blocking rule fires (human-review mandatory, professional boundary, user-value quantity/privacy, protected provenance, diagnostic completeness, severity mismatch, effect human-review, acceptance mixing, sorting).
